1   PP introduction

A protection profile written for this repository's tests.

6   Security requirements

6.1   Security functional requirements

FIA_UAU.2.1 The TSF shall require each user to be successfully authenticated before allowing any other TSF-mediated actions.

FDP_ACC.1.1 The TSF shall enforce the access control SFP on all objects.
